user.title: Enhanced Sidebar
user.description:
Adds a collapsible admin group to the sidebar. Panels that only administrators can see (dashboards, add-ons, HACS …) are moved into it automatically. All other dashboards stay in the sidebar as usual.

You can change the settings afterwards in the integration options.

abort.already_configured: Enhanced Sidebar is already set up.

init.title: Enhanced Sidebar
init.description: Changes take effect after reloading the page (in the app: close and reopen it).

data_description.group_name: Label of the entry in the sidebar.
data_description.group_icon: Icon of the entry, e.g. mdi:shield-account-outline.
data_description.group_style: "Dropdown" expands the entries inside the sidebar. "Popup" puts an admin button at the bottom of the sidebar (above Notifications) that opens a window next to the sidebar; on phones it appears at the bottom of the screen.
data_description.auto_detect_admin: All panels that only administrators can see go into the group. If off, only the entries under "Always add to group" are grouped.
data_description.auto_collapse: The group is collapsed on load and collapses again when you open a page outside it. It opens automatically on a page inside the group.
data_description.settings_in_group: Moves the "Settings" entry from the bottom of the sidebar into the group. The collapsed group shows the number of pending updates and repairs.
data_description.include: URL paths of panels that always belong in the group (the part after the slash, e.g. calendar-overview).
data_description.exclude: URL paths of panels that never go into the group, even if they are admin-only.
data_description.hidden: URL paths of panels removed from the sidebar for every user, e.g. history, logbook, media-browser.
data_description.order: URL paths in the order you want. Entries not listed follow afterwards in the normal order.
